name: Shock Theater
description: Classic horror from the silent era to the early 70s: Nosferatu, The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari, White Zombie, Night of the Living Dead, Carnival of Souls, House on Haunted Hill, Dementia 13 and a crypt full of Lugosi and Karloff programmers. Creature Double Feature Friday and Saturday nights at 11:00 pm.
curated: 2026-10-14: about 150 hours of hand-listed public-domain horror titles (1970 and earlier); trailers, clips, remakes and the 1979 Nosferatu excluded.

sources.title: Classic horror films (to 1970)
